name: Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) Computation
aliases: Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) Computation — 3D Cuboid Detection, PCA-based Bounding Box
definition: Computes oriented bounding boxes for 3D instances by analyzing the spatial distribution of assigned points.
summary: Oriented Bounding Box Computation fits an ellipsoid via PCA to determine optimal orientation and extent, providing tighter bounds than axis-aligned boxes for rotated instances.
